**Finding submitted: deviation (§ 14.2, p0054).**

The Section 13 licence framework is compliant — 13.1 extends the subscription grant to Affiliates and contractors, 13.2 gives a perpetual, irrevocable, paid-up licence to delivered software and Vendor Technology, and 13.3 permits transfer to an Affiliate or successor and limits revocation to uncured material breach after notice and cure.

The outlier is § 14.2, which licenses Deliverables on a **revocable, non-transferable** basis and **only during the Order Form term**, with no mention of Affiliates or contractors. Since Deliverables are work product created specifically for us and paid for by us, that sits at the rule's walk-away position. The redline conforms 14.2 to the Section 13 grant (perpetual, irrevocable, Affiliates and contractors covered, transferable per 13.3), leaving Vendor's ownership statement untouched, with the fallback (Affiliates on notice, M&A successor transfer) offered in the comment.
